claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Propranolol at 2.5 uM is a lipophilic cationic amphiphile that most plausibly kills cells through nonspecific lysosomal/physicochemical membrane stress rather than through beta-adrenergic receptor antagonism, which is not cytotoxic at this concentration.
